desc: Implement the helper function count(n) that uses digit DP to count beautiful numbers from 1 to n.
In count(n), convert n to a list of digits and initialize memoization dictionary.
Define the recursive DFS function with parameters (index, tight, current_sum, current_product) and base case checking divisibility.
In DFS, iterate over possible digits, update states, and accumulate results, using memoization to avoid recomputation.
Implement the main method to return count(r) - count(l-1).
Test the solution with provided examples to ensure correctness.
